The Chinese characters for Jeffrey

As a transliteration, Jeffrey is usually written 杰弗里 (Jié fú lǐ). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

杰
Jié
outstanding
弗
fú
not
里
lǐ
inside, a mile

Origin and meaning

Jeffrey comes from Germanic and means “peace (form of Geoffrey)”.

About the name Jeffrey

A friendly Germanic name that peaked in the mid-20th century.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Jeffrey suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
